zh-CN.title: 更顺手的广场与发布体验
items: 频道栏支持横向滑动，成员发言也可在同一行切换
默认打开好友圈，可分别设置探索、好友圈和个人发言的展示形式
先选择文字、照片、语音、视频或外部分享，再进入简洁编辑页，统一选择可见范围
我的频道集中展示发言额度与广场消息，新消息可从轻量提醒直接查看

en.title: A smoother Square and publishing flow
items: Swipe through channels, including member feeds, in one sticky navigation row
Square opens in Friends, with separate layout preferences for Explore, Friends and personal feeds
Choose text, photos, voice, video or an external share before entering a clean editor with unified audience options
My brings together posting allowance and notifications, with a lightweight shortcut for unread messages
